recipe.visualDefinition: A trio of stylized 3D animated female characters in white iridescent performance outfits, floating against a soft pastel gradient background with bokeh light effects and bold, metallic-textured typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Central character flanked by two supporting figures in a triangular formation
Iridescent clothing textures reflecting the pink and blue ambient lighting
Large-scale display typography anchored at the bottom third of the frame
Soft-focus background contrasting with sharp, high-gloss character renders
coreInvariants: Pastel lavender and cyan color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three characters centered vertically, occupying the upper two-thirds of the frame; central figure is slightly taller.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, metallic title block at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central character's face, move down to the title, then outward to the flanking characters.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample soft-focus space at the top and sides to allow for branding and atmospheric depth.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Lavender and soft blue gradient background providing a dreamy atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and silver in the costumes and typography to pop against the pastels.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant pink and magenta highlights in hair and lighting shadows.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (brightness) with moderate saturation; shadows are tinted rather than black.

characterSpecificRedesigns: O and P characters feature four-pointed star apertures
M and N have sharp, elongated descenders
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy stylized display face paired with a clean, wide-tracked geometric sans for legibility.

avoid: Thin weights for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric weight for the base skeleton.
Strong geometric foundations suitable for modification.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 3D render of three anime-style pop stars in white iridescent outfits, floating in a lavender and cyan dreamscape with soft bokeh lights. Leave the bottom third clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a three-line stacked title in a heavy geometric sans-serif. Use a holographic gradient fill and add star-shaped cutouts to the letters. Place a wide-tracked subtitle at the very bottom.

verificationChecks: Are there star motifs in the typography?
Is the lighting high-key and pastel?

adjustableVariables: Specific color of the character hair highlights
mustRedesign: The exact character facial features to avoid IP infringement
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent light direction on characters and text.
Ensure the iridescent effect doesn't make the text unreadable.
Verify the characters appear to be floating rather than standing.
Confirm the star motifs are sharp and intentional.
recipe.reuseFormula: 3D Character Trio + Iridescent Textures + Pastel Gradient + Heavy Geometric Typography with Star Accents
